conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
Honestly? I’ve been really down. I used to love coming home to my apartment, but now it just feels empty. I don't know how to make it feel... right again.
What do you think would help your apartment feel less empty?
I don't know. I've tried cleaning, decorating... nothing sticks. I just end up sitting on the couch and staring at the walls. It’s like I’m just going through the motions.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah. I read a page in a book and I forget what I read. It's like my mind is just... wandering. I get frustrated because I can't even finish a sentence.
How long has it been since you could read a page and remember it easily?
I don't know... a year? Maybe two? It used to be my favorite thing to do. Now it’s just hard.
How have you been sleeping lately?
Badly. I wake up in the middle of the night and just lie there. I can't turn my brain off. It's like I’m stuck in this... this limbo.
How long do you usually lie awake once you wake up?
Hours. Sometimes I get up and walk around, but mostly I just stare at the ceiling. I don't know how to make it stop.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Nothing. I used to love hiking, but now it feels like too much work. I just... I don't know, I feel like I've lost my spark.
When did you first notice that feeling of losing your spark?
I don't know... it was gradual, I guess. I used to have plans for the future, but now... I don't know what I want. It feels like I'm just drifting.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
I don't know. I just... I exist. I go through the motions, but there's no excitement, no joy. It’s just... dull.
When you say it's just dull, what does that feel like for you?
It feels... numb. Like I'm just a shell of who I used to be. I'm not living anymore. I'm just... existing.
When did this sense of emptiness start feeling this strong?
I think it started after the breakup. We were together for a long time, and then... it just ended. I felt lost, like I didn't know who I was anymore. And I never found my way back.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah. Like, what to eat for dinner? It feels like a huge choice. I get overwhelmed and just... I don't know, I usually just end up eating something bland.
How long has it been since choosing something simple, like a meal, started to feel so overwhelming?
I don't know... a year? Maybe two? It used to be easy. Now it’s just... exhausting.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
No. I'm always tired. I get up, go through the motions, and then... I just want to go back to bed.
How long has it been since you've felt this way?
A year. Maybe two. It just... it feels like it’s been going on forever.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
No. I don't know... I used to love music, but I haven't listened to a new album in months. I just... I don't have the energy for it.
When you think about listening to music now, what comes to mind?
Nothing. I look at my phone, and I think, "Why?" It used to make me so happy, but now... it just feels like too much work.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Everything. I wish I could go back and... I don't know, fix things. Make different choices. But I can't. I just have to... deal with it.
What's one choice you wish you could go back and make differently?
I wish I had stayed in the relationship. It was bad, but at least it was something. Now... I have nothing.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I feel like I've failed. I had a life, and I let it slip away. I don't know how to fix it, so I just... I just sit here and wait for it to end.
What does 'waiting for it to end' look like for you on a typical day?
It looks like me sitting on the couch, staring at the wall. Waiting for... something. I don't know what. I just want it to be over.
What parts of life feel most difficult or empty lately?
Everything. I used to have a life, and now... I just have this emptiness.
How do you see the next few weeks unfolding for you?
I don't know. I just... I'll keep existing, I guess. Until... until I don't.
How much of this feels like giving up versus feeling exhausted?
It’s both. I’m exhausted, but I’m also just... done. I don't know how to keep going anymore.
Do you feel like people would be better off without you, or is it more that you feel stuck?
I don't know. Maybe they would be better off. I don't know how to fix this.
How's your appetite been?
It's... gone. I don't have any interest in eating. It just feels like a waste of time.
How long has eating felt like a waste of time to you?
A year? Maybe two? I used to love food. Now... it just tastes like nothing.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
All the time. I cry over stupid things. Like a commercial. Or a song. It’s embarrassing.
